# Homeward — Task Outline

## Replication Notes

- Source: ColorLib Myhome (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/myhome/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/myhome/
- Font: Montserrat (Google Fonts)
- Brand purple: #55407d, accent green: #adc867
- Sections: Header > Hero > Search > Featured > Map > Hot Deal > Testimonials > Footer

## Components to Build

1. HeaderBar — purple top bar with contact info + social
2. Navbar — logo, nav links, submit listing button
3. Hero — full-width property image with title + price overlay
4. SearchBar — "Find your home" with 3 inputs + submit
5. FeaturedProperties — 3-column property card grid
6. MapSection — 7/5 split with location radio list
7. HotDeal — featured property detail with agent info
8. Testimonials — image + quote carousel
9. Footer — 4-column footer + copyright bar
